# Decision - Monthly visit rotation

## Context

The pilot for the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]] tried visits every two weeks, and volunteers could not keep up once the program passed 40 patrons.

## Decision

Each patron gets one visit a month in a fixed week, so the patron knows when to expect the volunteer. Items go out on a six-week loan to cover a late visit.

## Consequences

Readers who finish quickly get a larger bag, up to twelve items. Patrons who need something urgently, such as a book club title, can ask [[Wendeline Okafor]] for an extra drop-off.
